## Mexico City Family Weather Briefing: Jan 20–26, 2026
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/cloud-sun.svg

A mostly mild week with cool mornings and warmer afternoons. The best outdoor windows are the clear and sunny days, while Jan 24 looks like the main rain day.

## Day-by-Day Weather Outlook
| Date | Weather | High / Low | Family-friendly takeaway |
|---|---|---:|---|
| Jan 20 | Clear | 22 / 8°C | Comfortable and bright; great for parks and easy sightseeing. |
| Jan 21 | Clear | 21 / 7°C | Cool start, pleasant daytime weather; bring light layers. |
| Jan 22 | Hazy | 20 / 6°C | Visibility may be reduced; keep outdoor plans flexible. |
| Jan 23 | Cloudy | 18 / 6°C | Coolest day in the stretch; good for indoor museums or cafés. |
| Jan 24 | Rain | 19 / 7°C | Expect wet conditions; umbrellas and waterproof shoes help. |
| Jan 25 | Sunny | 21 / 8°C | One of the best days for being outside with the kids. |
| Jan 26 | Sunny | 22 / 9°C | Warmest-feeling day; ideal for longer outdoor time. |

## What Families Should Plan For
- **Mornings:** Chilly enough for sweaters or light jackets, especially for kids.
- **Afternoons:** Generally comfortable, with the warmest feel on Jan 25–26.
- **Rain prep:** Jan 24 is the day to keep indoor backup plans ready.
- **Air quality/visibility:** Jan 22 may feel a bit duller because of haze.
